verify.allOk: {n, plural, one {The roll matches the seed.} other {All # rolls match the seed.}}
verify.support: This shouldn't happen. Please contact support with this reference: {id}
verify.unsupported: This browser can't run the check. Try an up-to-date browser.
verify.howSteps: 1. SHA-256 of the seed bytes must equal the commitment. 2. Rolls are numbered from 0, counting opening rolls and ties. 3. For roll n, compute HMAC-SHA256 keyed with the seed over the text "match_id:n:k" for k = 0, 1, …. 4. Accept each byte below 252; die = (byte mod 6) + 1; the first two dice are the roll.
